description: This file is a shell script used for setting up, building, patching, and testing a complex C++ project involving multiple repositories and components. It manages dependencies, checks out repositories at specific tags or branches, applies patches, configures and builds components with CMake and Ninja, runs tests, and generates coverage reports. The script incorporates logic to reuse existing build artifacts, handle clean rebuilds and recloning, and verify the presence of expected build outputs like plugin shared objects.

methods.name: ensure_git_checkout_ref
methods.description: Ensures a git repository at a directory is checked out to a specific ref (tag, branch, or remote ref) in a best-effort, non-interactive way.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout
methods.description: Ensures a repository exists at a specified directory; clones if missing, and checks out a ref. Can force recloning based on global flags.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir
methods.description: Applies a patch to a repository directory in an idempotent, non-interactive manner, handling cases where the patch was previously applied.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_install
methods.description: Configures, builds, and installs a CMake project, optionally skipping if artifacts already exist unless forced rebuild is requested.

methods.name: have_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command/tool is available in the current environment.
